title: The Plan for a Tiny Museum
youtube_title: The Plan for a Tiny Museum | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Milo about plan for a tiny museum on the shelf. Milo wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
